name: RC-B10-0304/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human cost of Russia’s war against Ukraine and the urgent need to end Russian aggression: the situation of illegally detained civilians and prisoners of war, and the continued bombing of civilians
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to stop its war against Ukraine, withdraw its troops and release all detained Ukrainians. It asks the European Union to send more weapons and money to Ukraine, to punish Russia harder with sanctions, and to make sure Russian officials and soldiers face justice for war crimes. It also demands that Russia let international inspectors visit prisoners and return deported Ukrainian children. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament urges more military aid and sanctions; no law changes yet.
- It affects Ukraine, Russia, and European Union governments and companies.
- Next, European Union governments decide whether to act on these calls.
